row.name: Force Addiction
row.description: The character is addicted to using the Force, feeling a constant craving for its power. They suffer withdrawal penalties (e.g., -1 to all rolls, reduced FP recovery) if they go too long without using a Force power. This addiction can be exploited by those who control access to Force-rich environments or artifacts, or by offering opportunities for power use. Range: -10 to -25 points.
